description: Write a message in a chat, as yourself — as the screen sends it: the chat's people see it at once, and it is told by push and by letter to whoever it calls: in a direct chat the other person, in a group or a project's chat only who it mentions ([~username], the handle list_users gives) or answers (replyTo). An agent of the chat answers when mentioned ([~agent:product]) or replied to, and in a chat with an agent every message is a question to it. A project's chat takes a message from whoever may comment in the project. Answers with 'notified' (who this actually tells, and why: direct, mention, reply — never yourself), 'unresolvedMentions' (what looked like a mention and told nobody, with a reason: unknown, inactive, self, not_in_chat, or an agent's) and 'agents' (the agents it called and their requests). A wrong handle is kept as written and never refused, so that list is the only sign it did not land. Text only — files are sent from the screen.

body.description: The message, Markdown — with $…$ formulas and [~username] mentions. At most 32 KB.

chatId.description: The chat's id, as list_chats gives it.

replyTo.description: The message of this chat this one answers.
